ocument

eekends or holidays by visit.

nterview 2026.12.14.(Mon) – 2026.12.18.(Fri)

Announcement of

Tuition Payment
2027.01.18.(Mon) -
 2027.01.20(Wed)
[Applicants who are residing in Korea]
•  Payment in person: Visit KB Bank at Ajou University with tuition fee invoice during
business hours (09:00–16:00) and receive assistance.
• Bank transfer: Transfer the tuition fee to the account number stated on the tuition invoice.

For applicants residing overseas, the tuition 
payment schedule and method may diﬀer.

• Separate instructions will be provided

ailure to pay within the designated period will result in admission cancellation.

dmission Package January ~ February 2027
